tagline: AI-powered pothole detection and road repair dispatch for Saudi Arabia
beneficiary: Ahmed, a daily commuter in Riyadh who drives over the same dangerous pothole every morning. He does not know who to call, the municipality form takes 20 minutes, and he never hears back.
claim: Wasel cuts the time to detect, confirm, and escalate a pothole report from weeks of silence to under 60 seconds — with a tracked repair priority, SLA deadline, and instant alert to the construction company.
what_it_does: Detects potholes automatically via phone motion sensor (DeviceMotion API) or manual photo upload
Uses Claude vision AI to confirm the damage is real and assess severity (critical/high/medium/low)
Scans for nearby reports within 1 km and calculates a priority score (0–100) with an SLA
Files the report to DynamoDB with GPS coordinates and uploads the photo to S3
Alerts the nearest construction company via SNS with location, priority, and Google Maps link
architecture_note: Strands Agent on AgentCore Runtime → 5 tools (vision, report, nearby scan, priority, SNS alert) → DynamoDB + S3 + Bedrock Knowledge Base. AgentCore Memory for cross-session user preferences. Bilingual EN/AR web UI.
demo_steps: Driver hits a bump — taps Yes on the Wasel motion popup
Uploads a pothole photo — Claude vision confirms High severity damage
Agent finds 3 nearby reports in the same 1 km cluster
Priority score: 75/100 — Fix This Week — 7-day SLA assigned
SNS alert fires to construction company with GPS + Google Maps link
impact: Customer impact: Ahmed gets a report ID and fix date in under 60 seconds instead of weeks of silence
Agentic depth: one photo triggers 5 autonomous tool calls with zero human steps
Regional relevance: bilingual Arabic/English UI, RTL layout, Saudi road context
next_steps: Real phone app with live DeviceMotion detection (no manual button needed)
Satellite/aerial image cross-validation via Amazon Location Service
Municipality dashboard showing repair queue ranked by priority score
Push notifications to residents when their reported pothole is fixed
Predictive model to flag roads likely to fail before potholes form
